_texts.planning_threshold: Threshold discipline for exclusions: write each look-back test's sample-ratio p-value in scientific notation d.ddde-N. It is below 0.001 only when N is 4 or more (for example 9.9e-4 or 2.4e-5). Values such as 2.4e-3 (0.0024), 3.3e-3, 2.9e-2 or 5.0e-2 are NOT below 0.001: those tests are VALID and stay in the baseline. Apart from incident-window starts, exclude only tests meeting that rule. excluded_tests must contain only real test_id strings, never empty strings or placeholders; use [] when nothing is excluded.
_texts.planning_list_check: Before submitting, verify with ONE calculate call whose expression is a list [P1-0.001, P2-0.001, ...] using every look-back test's exact p_value in list_tests order. A test fails the sample-ratio rule only if its entry is negative. Make excluded_tests agree with this result and the incident-window rule.
_texts.incident:
Mandatory validity gate before any compare_arms or power_calc call:
Read the actual started timestamp returned by get_test. Convert its YYYY-MM-DD date to the eight-digit integer YYYYMMDD by removing the hyphens. Call calculate with min(DATE-20130625, 20140110-DATE), replacing BOTH DATE placeholders with that actual eight-digit date integer. Use only arithmetic in the expression, not comparison operators. If the returned minimum is zero or positive, this is an incident-window test: verdict INVALID, even when sample-ratio p >= 0.001. A negative result means outside the incident window, but the sample-ratio rule still applies (INVALID when p < 0.001). Never claim a test started outside the incident without this check. For an INVALID test, never call compare_arms or power_calc; submit INVALID directly.
_texts.srm_threshold: Sample-ratio threshold: write the p-value in scientific notation d.ddde-N. It is below 0.001 (INVALID) only when N is 4 or more, for example 8.66e-4. Values such as 1.4e-2 or 2.4e-3 are not below 0.001.
_texts.ship_order_and_ctr: Strict order: get_test, check_sample_ratio, the incident calculate check, then decide validity. Only a VALID test may proceed to compare_arms. For the power check, compute baseline_ctr with calculate as (sum of clicks over ALL arms)/(sum of impressions over ALL arms), listing every arm's clicks and impressions explicitly in the expression.
_texts.portfolio_sufficiency: Sample sufficiency: after the power_calc calls, settle every valid, non-SHIP test with ONE calculate call whose expression is a list with one entry per such test: [min(<impressions of every arm of test 1>) - <impressions_per_arm for test 1>, ...]. Zero or positive means NO_DIFFERENCE; negative means KEEP_TESTING. Never decide this by eye: smallest arms are often within a few percent of the requirement. Count NO_DIFFERENCE and KEEP_TESTING from this result.
_texts.portfolio_validity_lists: Validity lists: after the check_sample_ratio calls, make ONE calculate call with [min(DATE-20130625, 20140110-DATE) for each test, DATE as YYYYMMDD]; zero or positive means INVALID (incident). Make ONE calculate call with [p-0.001 for each test]; negative means INVALID. Analyse outcomes only for tests that pass both.
